arithmetic: Python fractions.Fraction; no floating-point proof decisions
scope: Finite kernel identities, bounds, first-promotion reductions and prime valuations, full-model certificate polynomials, exact Yule tails, generic bracket updates, the full-tree coefficient recurrence, reduced population-certificate arithmetic, fixed-order Laplace derivative tails, generator and Hankel obstructions, and modified-model root brackets. Analytic proofs are in the manuscripts. The general original-model computability algorithm is not implemented by these scripts.
